verdict.rationale: Asking about an official hosting/deploy platform's status page is a fair question for a fullstack-capable UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence shows SSR and serverless runtime support but never mentions an official SolidJS hosting platform, status page, or incident history.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check a public status page and incident history for the framework's official hosting/deploy platform before relying on it in production
